note: Set A captures the revision history (revisions 2–5) and title-block facts (client, website, BOREALIS) plus the dining-table DATA & POWER note, all supported verbatim, but it also fabricates several bindings: SK expanded to "skirt," a 3'-0" dining-table height, a 6" dining-table clearance, and a 4'-0" width for the DIRTT BREATHE WALL (that dimension belongs to the center-module section). Set B binds dimensions more defensibly (North/East Island widths, MWK05 width, laundry width, the 1" either-side clearance correctly tied to the laundry section, gable and bulkhead finishes), but it omits the entire revision table and title block, invents conditions ("excluding 6\" offset," "offset from dining table," "sink section"), and states 8'-4" as 8 ft. Each set has roughly comparable fabrication/misbinding errors and comparable trivial claims, and their coverage gaps are complementary, so they are about equally good.
